leaderboard.reason: Removed leaderboard toolbar/control, UI method, score submission/read functions and SDK binding. Local best/ghost implementation retained. Actual menu and DNF/results/rematch have no leaderboard control.

multiplayer.reason: Removed online mode control, persisted online-mode acceptance, room transport class and instance, create/invite/join callbacks, server meta and SDK room hooks. Same-computer split-screen remains native offline functionality, untested. No server or network matchmaking remains.

advertising.reason: Read final game source and native layout/audio module; no advertising SDK/init/call or ad reward UI. Real local power pickups only.

payments.reason: Removed unused host shim including purchase placeholder; final game has no payment initialization/call/control. Native paint shop selects colors without money.

gameplay.reason: Menu/rules -> real input and powers -> original timeout/DNF results -> rematch -> menu; does not claim player lap finish.

resources.reason: Local Three modules and original music loaded; procedural track/cars/scene render.

characters.reason: Player and five bots render and participate; bots finish with real times.

animation.reason: Car motion, nitro trails/VFX, camera follow and animated podium observed.

ui.reason: Offline menu, rules, countdown, speed, position, inventory, pause, results, rematch and restored settings inspected.
